task_completion.description: A browser bookmark folder named 'Mountain Airports' contains the three AirNav pages.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser UI showing a folder named 'Mountain Airports' in the bookmarks bar or manager containing links for KASE, KTEX, and KEGE.

task_completion.description: The 'LOC/DME-E' or 'LOC/DME-E (SPECIAL)' approach plate for KASE is downloaded.

task_completion.visual_evidence: File explorer or text editor showing the file path ~/Documents/airport_briefing.json.

task_completion.description: The JSON file contains the correct technical data (elevation, runway, frequency, ARTCC) for all three airports.

integrity.description: The agent used the web browser GUI to find information rather than just generating the file via terminal.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo a pre-prepared string into the JSON file without visiting the sources.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the agent extracting data from the browser before writing the JSON file.

integrity.description: The PDF was downloaded from the AirNav/FAA links, not created as a dummy file.
